### Tasting Notes

#### Flavor \#1

While each barrel is unique, they all retain the Russell's Reserve signature Rye DNA, with notes of spicy pepper, vanilla and tobacco.

#### Flavor \#2

Russell's Reserve barrels are always selected from the “center cut” of our timber rickhouses, Floors 3-5, because they are exposed to the least temperature variation, therefore offer the highest consistency of flavor.

### About

Russell’s Reserve has continuously produced some of the best rye whiskeys on the market, and this non-chill filtered, 104 proof single barrel rye is no exception. This complex whiskey stands up beautifully in a Manhattan or simply enjoyed over a large ice cube.
